Subject: Approval request: PLG signup credit grant for Hearthly Health

Hi team,

Quick ask — Hearthly Health (PLG signup) just converted a set of 12 engineers to active trials and their usage profile indicates they will need additional headroom to finish an internal pilot. They pushed back on our standard self-serve credits and asked for an increased grant to avoid throttling while they validate metrics.

Summary:
- Request: $15,000 in free credits (to be issued as a one-time promo credit on self-serve account HH-2026-09)
- Why: They are instrumenting a 3-week pilot that will generate >= 1M tokens; critical to confirm latency/cost improvements before committing to Dedicated.
- Ask: Leadership sign-off to approve and marketing/ops token to create promo; finance ticket to log as promotional expense.
- Customer contacts: Sam Gutierrez (engineering lead) and procurement@hearthlyhealth.com.

Notes / risks:
- This is above the standard $3k PLG grant; it's a precedent we should document but the prospect is early-stage with clear expansion signs (multiple product teams).
- I attached the proposed promo terms and the minimal mutual action plan (MMP). If approved, I will issue the promo code and confirm via HubSpot.

Proposed conditions: credits valid for 90 days, single-use promo attached to account HH-2026-09, require simple ROI check-in (2 weeks after pilot ends).

Please let me know if you approve or want a reduced amount. I need a response by 12:00pm PT to honor their timing (they are kicking off on Monday).

Thanks,
Avery
